'''Nathalie Japkowicz''' is a Canadian computer scientist specializing in [[machine learning]]. She is a professor and department chair of computer science at the [[American University College of Arts and Sciences]].

== Life ==
Japkowicz completed a B.Sc. at [[McGill University]] in 1988.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Professor and Department Chair, Computer Science |url=https://www.american.edu/cas/faculty/japkowic.cfm |access-date=2023-04-29 |website=American University |language=en}}</ref> She earned an M.Sc. from the [[University of Toronto]] in 1990.<ref name=":0" /> She completed a Ph.D. at [[Rutgers University]] in 1999.<ref name=":0" />

Japkowicz worked at the [[University of Ottawa]] in the school of [[electrical engineering]] and computer science.<ref name=":0" /> She was the lead of its laboratory for research on [[machine learning]] for defense security.<ref name=":0" />

Japkowicz is a professor and department chair of computer science at the [[American University College of Arts and Sciences]].<ref name=":0" /> She researches [[artificial intelligence]], machine learning, [[data mining]], and [[big data]] analysis.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Homepage of Nathalie Japkowicz |url=http://fs2.american.edu/japkowic/www/?_ga=2.243763328.424416255.1682718028-1360799871.1682718028 |access-date=2023-04-29 |website=fs2.american.edu}}</ref>
